That's a frustrating way for the night to have gone, especially with guests having to walk that far — I'm sorry.

I don't have the authority to make a call on compensation or liability here, and I don't want to guess at something this important. Let me get our events manager to look into this and follow up with you directly — they'll email you today with next steps.

Can you share the event date and the name the booking was under, so I can pass it along right away?
